events.title: Haru Matsuri: Cherry Blossom Spring Festival
events.description: An evening celebration of spring featuring traditional Yukata dress codes, Japanese street food stalls (Takoyaki, Dango), Koto music performances, and lantern lighting under blooming cherry trees.

events.title: Shodo: Japanese Calligraphy Masterclass
events.description: Learn the ancient art of Japanese brush calligraphy (書道). Understand brush control, ink grinding on Suzuri stones, and write your own favorite Kanji on handmade Washi rice paper.
highlights: Traditional Sumi ink & Fude brushes provided
Guidance on Kaisho and Gyosho styles
Take home your framed personalized Kanji scroll
